description: This file defines a middleware component for an ASP.NET Core application that manages a correlation ID for tracing requests. It ensures each request has a valid correlation ID, generates one if missing or invalid, stores it in the HttpContext for downstream access, adds it to the response headers, and integrates with structured logging for observability.

classes.name: CorrelationIdMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that handles correlation ID management for incoming HTTP requests in ASP.NET Core applications.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main middleware method that processes each HTTP request to assign, propagate, and log the correlation ID.

methods.name: ResolveCorrelationId
methods.description: Helper method that extracts, validates, or generates a correlation ID for the current request.
